title: Development and performance evaluation of a hygienic and portable small-scale cassava grater for safe food processing
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00242G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kehinde A. Adeyeye, Cornelius Folahan Oladipupo, Sanni Sodiq, Tomilola F. Oguntunde, Tosin O. Olanrewaju
A hygienic, portable cassava grating machine was developed and tested, delivering high throughput, improved food safety, and affordable small-scale processing for rural and household users.
